_readme: Allow-list of Higgsfield API models the team may use. 'path' is the endpoint after https://api.higgsfield.ai/ exactly as shown on the model's page in console.higgsfield.ai. 'max_usd' is a safety ceiling: a generation whose estimate is above it is refused, and it is also used as the reservation if the estimate endpoint is unavailable. Add more with: npm run admin -- models:add

models.label: Seedance 2.0 — text to video
models.notes: Inputs: prompt, resolution ('720p'), duration (seconds), aspect_ratio ('16:9' | '9:16' | '1:1'), generate_audio (bool).
